title: Your Order to Books Pipeline, Watched and Self-Healing

sections.label: 1 - AN ORDER COMES IN FROM EITHER CHANNEL
sections.note: Faire wholesale and Shopify DTC land on separate hooks and get flattened into one shape, so every downstream step reads the same fields no matter which channel sent it.

sections.label: 2 - THE THREE PLACES IT USUALLY BREAKS
sections.note: An unmapped SKU, an Unleashed call that times out or hits a rate limit, and a Xero call on an expired token. Each one gets a gate, and each gate has somewhere safe to put the order instead of dropping it.

sections.label: 3 - CLOSE THE LOOP
sections.note: The channel gets the fulfilment and invoice number written back, and every run leaves a row behind with timings, so a slow step is visible before it becomes a broken one.

sections.label: 4 - EVERY MORNING, PROVE IT IS HEALTHY
sections.note: A 7am pass over yesterday's log and dead letters, counted and posted. Green means the numbers reconcile. Red names the orders that need a human before anyone has to ask.

sections.label: 5 - NOTHING FAILS QUIETLY
sections.note: One error trigger covers every workflow in the instance, so a breakdown announces itself with the workflow, the node and the order id instead of being found days later in a stock count.

nodes.label: 2 - Normalize: SKUs, Quantities, Customer, Channel
nodes.notes: One payload shape for both channels, so nothing downstream has to know where the order came from.

nodes.label: 3b - Alert: Unmapped SKU, Order Parked
nodes.notes: The order waits instead of half-posting a sales order that has to be unpicked later.

nodes.label: 4 - Unleashed: Create the Sales Order and Allocate Stock
5b - Back Off 60 Seconds and Retry
nodes.notes: Rate limits and timeouts are temporary, so the retry happens before a human ever hears about it.

nodes.label: 6 - Xero: Create the Invoice Against the Right Contact
7b - Dead Letter: Order, Error, Payload, for Replay
nodes.notes: The exact payload is kept, so a fixed order is replayed in one click instead of rebuilt by hand.

nodes.label: 8 - Shopify or Faire: Write Back Fulfilment and Invoice Number
9 - Run Log: Order, Channel, Each Step, Duration
11 - Read Yesterday's Runs and Dead Letters
12 - Health Check: Orders In, Invoiced, Parked, Failed
nodes.notes: Orders in has to equal invoiced plus parked plus failed. When it does not, that is the bug, found at 7am.

nodes.label: 13 - Post the Health Report, Green or Red
15 - Alert With Workflow, Node, Order Id
